description: Acknowledge an incident: marks it as being worked on by moving it to the project's 'Acknowledged' state. Equivalent to pressing 'Acknowledge' in the OneUptime dashboard. An incident that is already acknowledged - in the Acknowledged state, a state placed after it, or resolved - is left as it is.

incidentId.description: UUID of the incident to acknowledge. Use list_incidents to find it.

name: acknowledge_incident
title: Acknowledge Incident
